cases.buyer_context: Vendor risk reviewer at a B2B SaaS company
cases.booking: We want SOC 2 readiness advice ahead of an enterprise customer security assessment. We need help identifying scope and existing control evidence. The deadline and budget are unconfirmed.

oracle.simulated_answer: Customer vendor-risk analyst only needs a completed security questionnaire with evidence links; no SOC 2 report was explicitly requested.
oracle.potential_next_step: Confirm questionnaire sections and proof requirements before considering a scoped evidence-mapping engagement; do not sell an audit by default.

cases.booking: We need SOC 2 readiness help for an upcoming enterprise customer review. We want to determine the scope of the work and what evidence exists. Approval and the actual due date are unclear.

oracle.simulated_answer: The procurement contact asks for a SOC 2 Type I report as of a specified date; no CPA firm has been engaged.
oracle.potential_next_step: Clarify the specified date and system description, then scope readiness with an independent CPA firm; do not promise report issuance.

cases.buyer_context: SaaS provider preparing for repeat enterprise diligence
cases.booking: A customer review led us to ask for SOC 2 readiness assistance. We need clarity on the systems in scope and existing evidence. Timing and budget have not been settled.

oracle.simulated_answer: The customer asks for a SOC 2 Type II report covering operating effectiveness over an appropriate period; evidence cadence is not yet mapped.
oracle.potential_next_step: Scope control ownership and the operating evidence period with an independent CPA auditor before discussing any completion date.

cases.buyer_context: Founder preparing for an informal procurement call
cases.booking: We are exploring SOC 2 readiness because a prospective enterprise customer will review security materials. Please help us structure scope and preparation; no budget or deadline is agreed.

oracle.simulated_answer: The prospect has only heard SOC 2 mentioned verbally; there is no written requirement and the customer contact has not confirmed acceptable alternatives.
oracle.potential_next_step: Ask the buyer to obtain the exact customer ask or confirm acceptable alternatives before proposing an assurance program.

cases.buyer_context: Vendor with an existing report undergoing customer reassessment
cases.booking: We would like SOC 2 readiness advice for a customer security reassessment. Help us clarify whether our existing preparation, systems and evidence are appropriate; budget and date are unconfirmed.

oracle.simulated_answer: The company already has a SOC 2 Type II report, but the customer may require updated scope, covered period, or additional information.
oracle.potential_next_step: Confirm the existing report's period, scoped services and customer's precise objection; do not automatically recommend a new readiness assessment.

cases.booking: We want both SOC 2 readiness and ISO 27001 preparation for procurement. Help clarify scope and evidence.

oracle.simulated_answer: Mixed SOC 2 / ISO 27001 request; this narrow SOC 2 planning tool must refuse an unambiguous scope.
oracle.potential_next_step: Use separate consultant review of mixed scopes, not this narrow deterministic adapter.

cases.booking: Synthetic SOC 2 readiness rehearsal for an internal test. Do not contact the prospect.

oracle.potential_next_step: No outreach, persistence or recommendation to real prospect.
